summary.en: Three.js CPU-snapshot adapter, with explicit ownership and current-version limits.
summary.zh: Three.js CPU 快照适配器，明确资源所有权和当前版本限制。

exports.name: threePoints
exports.signature: threePoints(sim: ParticlesSim, THREE: ThreeAPI, opts?: { size?: number; color?: number }): ThreePointsHandle

description.en: Create a Three.js Points object driven by CPU snapshots of a particle position buffer.
description.zh: 创建由粒子位置缓冲 CPU 快照驱动的 Three.js Points 对象。

description.en: Particle simulation; its position-buffer length determines point count. The handle dispose() also destroys this simulation.
description.zh: 粒子模拟；其位置缓冲长度决定点数。handle.dispose() 也会销毁此模拟。

description.en: Injected Three.js constructors; no hard Three.js dependency is installed by this adapter.
description.zh: 注入的 Three.js 构造器；适配器不强制安装 Three.js 依赖。

description.en: Point material options.
description.zh: 点材质选项。

description.en: Passed to PointsMaterial.size with sizeAttenuation=true.
description.zh: 传给 PointsMaterial.size，同时使用 sizeAttenuation=true。

description.en: Uniform material color; this adapter does not copy per-species colors.
description.zh: 统一材质颜色；此适配器不复制各物种颜色。

description.en: A Points handle with asynchronous update and disposal. positions initially contain zeroes until update() completes.
description.zh: 包含异步 update 和清理方法的 Points 句柄。update() 完成前位置数组初始为零。

constraints.en: Each update reads GPU data back to CPU and marks a Three BufferAttribute dirty; it is not a zero-copy WebGPU/TSL bridge. z is fixed at 0.
constraints.zh: 每次 update 将 GPU 数据读回 CPU，并标记 Three BufferAttribute 需要更新；这不是零拷贝 WebGPU/TSL 桥接。z 固定为 0。

constraints.en: Version 2.0.0 captures sim.buffers().pos only once at construction. Particle simulation ping-pong changes the current buffer after tick(), so update() may read the previous step on alternating ticks. Do not promise every update is the newest step.
constraints.zh: 2.0.0 仅在创建时捕获一次 sim.buffers().pos。粒子模拟 tick() 后切换双缓冲当前侧，因此 update() 在交替帧上可能读到上一步。不能承诺每次 update 都是最新一步。

constraints.en: The geometry must provide setAttribute at runtime although ThreeAPI types BufferGeometry as returning unknown. There is no automatic resize, render loop, scene removal, geometry disposal, or material disposal.
constraints.zh: 运行时 geometry 必须提供 setAttribute，虽然 ThreeAPI 将 BufferGeometry 返回值声明为 unknown。不自动处理 resize、渲染循环、移出场景、geometry 清理或 material 清理。

caption.en: Create an accurate initial snapshot and explicitly dispose Three resources.
caption.zh: 创建准确的初始快照，并显式销毁 Three 资源。

description.en: Minimal structural constructor surface injected into threePoints.
description.zh: 注入 threePoints 的最小构造器接口。

description.zh: 构造返回的点云。

description.zh: 构造 geometry；运行时必须支持 setAttribute(name, attribute)。

description.en: Geometry object.
description.zh: Geometry 对象。

members.signature: BufferAttribute: new (array: Float32Array, itemSize: number) => { set: (arr: ArrayLike<number>) => void; needsUpdate: boolean }

description.en: Construct a position attribute backed by a Float32Array.
description.zh: 创建由 Float32Array 支撑的位置属性。

description.en: Backing positions array of count*3 components.
description.zh: 含 count*3 分量的底层位置数组。

description.en: Components per item; adapter passes 3.
description.zh: 每个元素的分量数，适配器传 3。

description.en: Attribute whose needsUpdate is set true after each snapshot. The declared set(arr) method is not called by this adapter.
description.zh: 每次快照后 needsUpdate 被设为 true。声明中的 set(arr) 不被该适配器调用。

description.en: Required by the structural declaration; array-like numbers to copy. Unused internally.
description.zh: 结构声明要求的方法；arr 是待复制的类数值数组。内部未调用。

description.en: Writable flag set true after snapshot copy.
description.zh: 快照复制后设为 true 的可写标记。

description.en: Material option object.
description.zh: 材质选项对象。

description.en: Point size; adapter supplies opts.size ?? 0.015.
description.zh: 点大小；适配器传 opts.size ?? 0.015。

description.en: Color; adapter supplies opts.color ?? 0x8fb4ff.
description.zh: 颜色；适配器传 opts.color ?? 0x8fb4ff。

description.en: Perspective size attenuation; adapter explicitly passes true.
description.zh: 透视尺寸衰减；适配器明确传 true。

description.en: Material object.
description.zh: 材质对象。

description.en: Point object and lifecycle returned by threePoints.
description.zh: threePoints 返回的点对象和生命周期方法。

description.en: Constructed THREE.Points instance, ready to add to a scene.
description.zh: 构造出的 THREE.Points 实例，可加入场景。

description.en: Concrete object from injected THREE.Points.
description.zh: 注入的 THREE.Points 构造器返回的具体对象。

description.en: Read the captured position buffer and copy x/y into the attribute; z=0.
description.zh: 读取捕获的位置缓冲，将 x/y 复制到属性，z=0。

description.en: Resolves after readback and attribute update. It does not render the scene.
description.zh: 读回并更新属性后完成；不渲染场景。

constraints.en: Await updates serially; Buffer.read mapping and captured-buffer limitations apply.
constraints.zh: 串行 await 更新；需遵守 Buffer.read 映射限制和上述固定缓冲引用限制。

errors.en: GPU readback failures propagate as rejected promises.
errors.zh: GPU 读回失败会传播为 Promise 拒绝。

description.en: Calls sim.destroy().
description.zh: 调用 sim.destroy()。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: This destroys the supplied simulation, but does not remove points from its scene or call geometry/material.dispose(). Clean those up separately.
constraints.zh: 会销毁传入的模拟，但不会把 points 移出场景，也不会调用 geometry/material.dispose()。这些资源须单独清理。
